context_notes: Phase 13 is a read-path migration closing v1.2 audit gaps I-1/F-1, I-3 and I-4 (I-2, the BambooHR refresh bypass, was explicitly deferred to backlog). Its central claim verified cleanly under direct code inspection: roster and Excel export both resolve from agent_day_hours, the retired Agent.contractedHoursPerDay scalar is genuinely excluded from the read path (it stays a LIVE field by decision D-05 — do not drop the column or add a migration removing it; five writers still touch it), the read path bulk-fetches rather than N+1ing, and the new PUT endpoint is tenant+desk scoped before any per-day write. Both remaining gaps are one-line frontend fixes in DeskAgents.tsx. IMPORTANT for the gap run: gap 2 traces to a real self-contradiction inside 13-04-PLAN.md — its <action> prose says 'the empty string when hasRow is false' while its own must_haves.truths demand the literal 'Not set (default)', and the executor followed the action text. Fix the plan text too, not just the code, or a replan will reintroduce it. Separately, 13-REVIEW.md WR-01/WR-02 are real defects the verifier independently re-confirmed but that map to no declared must-have, so they were not gap-scored: the surviving bulk setContractedHours endpoint has no upper-bound check (a value like 999.99 overflows NUMERIC(5,2) into an opaque 500 AND breaks the E1 'at most 5 characters' truth via undeclared precondition), and a malformed {day} path segment returns 500 rather than the 400 the plan claimed, because GlobalExceptionHandler has a catch-all Exception handler and no MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException handler. Worth folding both into the gap-closure run. Codebase drift is at 14 structural elements since last mapping (advisory only).
